item.title: The AI Citation-Recommendation Gap: Citations and Business Recommendations in Google AI Mode and AI Overviews, Perth 2026 (Research Summary)
item.description:
Dorian Menard
In 1,942 Google AI answers to 200 questions about 20 Perth industries (9 to 13 November 2026), 91.1% of Google AI Mode business recommendations came with no citation to the business's own website. Being cited and being recommended depended mostly on the type of question, and recommendations changed from day to day. A plain-English summary of how to measure AI visibility properly. item.title: STARLI · FAMILY 36 BOTANICAL SKINCARE EFFICACY EVIDENCE Scientific & Technical Notebook F176–F180 | Research Working Edition | 100,000+ English words Five flagship research annotations — Zenodo-ready front matter F176 | Botanical Moisturization Measurement at the Limit The corneum hydration proxy measurement flagship asks whether dielectric response, transient surface wetness, and corneum analogue water retention can be separated from surface film capacitance, ambient humidity drift, and electrode contact pressure. Its primary candidate endpoint is calibrated hydration capacitance proxy (instrument units). A rigorous design compares appearance-matched vehicle under identical humidity acclimation and requires gravimetric water exchange with blinded dielectric instrument calibration. The decisive failure condition is that the capacitance signal improves while independent water-mass evidence remains unchanged. These are prospective, nonclinical research designs, not clinical or retail product efficacy results. F177 | Causal Evidence for Botanical Skin Barrier Improvement at the Limit The causal barrier-water-flux contrast flagship asks whether vehicle-specific occlusion, diffusion resistance, and reconstructed barrier water flux can be separated from seasonal humidity, spontaneous recovery, and unequal boundary-layer air flow. Its primary candidate endpoint is counterfactual difference in water flux (g m^-2 h^-1). A rigorous design compares time-matched vehicle with blinded randomized surrogate assignment and requires mass-loss flux independently checked against instrument TEWL calibration. The decisive failure condition is that the contrast vanishes when air flow, surface area, or vehicle occlusion is matched. These are prospective, nonclinical research designs, not clinical or retail product efficacy results. F178 | Blinded Assessment of Botanical Soothing Effects at the Limit The blinding integrity and soothing-response discrimination flagship asks whether sensory masking, observer expectation, inflammatory mediator surrogates, and unblinding risk can be separated from fragrance leakage, observer expectation, and cell-loss-related mediator suppression. Its primary candidate endpoint is masked-arm identification accuracy (percent). A rigorous design compares odor-, color- and texture-matched vehicle with concealed allocation and requires blinding questionnaire paired with model tissue viability and cytokine blanks. The decisive failure condition is that outcome contrast tracks treatment guesses or tissue loss rather than allocation. These are prospective, nonclinical research designs, not clinical or retail product efficacy results. F179 | Botanical Blend Versus Single-Ingredient Efficacy at the Limit The blend-versus-single contribution and interaction estimands flagship asks whether mass-conserving blend design, factorial interaction, ingredient substitution and carrier effects can be separated from dose imbalance, vehicle differences, additive effects misnamed as synergy. Its primary candidate endpoint is adjusted blend versus single-ingredient contrast (predeclared endpoint units). A rigorous design compares total-mass-matched single ingredient, factorial component controls and base vehicle and requires locked 2 by 2 factorial design with chemical composition and endpoint assay checks. The decisive failure condition is that the alleged interaction collapses after total loading and carrier composition are equalized. These are prospective, nonclinical research designs, not clinical or retail product efficacy results. F180 | Botanical Nanocosmetic Efficacy Evidence-Chain Reconstruction at the Limit The multi-site evidence provenance and claim-release governance flagship asks whether site-to-site transportability, uncertainty calibration, missing outcomes and noncompensatory safety vetoes can be separated from selective reporting, post-hoc changes, missing adverse events and calibration drift. Its primary candidate endpoint is held-out site reconstruction error and adverse-reporting completeness (native + percent). A rigorous design compares frozen multi-site analysis protocol with matched vehicle and blinded adjudication and requires independent site audit using raw logs and immutable analysis scripts. The decisive failure condition is that performance appears only after excluding failed sites or unreported adverse outcomes. These are prospective, nonclinical research designs, not clinical or retail product efficacy results. Research position: The five flags are deliberately distinct. The historical sensibility of Bencao Gangmu and Eastern philosophical reflection shape the question of material provenance, balance and preparation, while causal inference relies on current measurements, blind controls and independent reconstruction. The 3D plots in the research PDF are synthetic and explicitly reproducible; they are not experimental observations.
